function value(a?: { number?: number; inner?: { n?: number } }): void {
  if (a?.number) console.log(a?.number.toFixed());
  if (a?.["number"] !== undefined) console.log(a?.["number"].toFixed());
  if (a?.inner?.n !== undefined) console.log(a?.inner?.n.toFixed());
}

function call(a?: { compute?: () => number }): void {
  if (a?.compute) console.log(a?.compute());
  if (a?.["compute"] !== undefined) console.log(a?.["compute"]());
}

value({ number: 2, inner: { n: 3 } });
value(undefined);
call({ compute: () => 5 });
call(undefined);
